```python
from seedemu import *
from seedemu.services.ethereum import *

# Create emulator base with 10 stub AS and 3 hosts per stub AS
emu = Emulator()
base = makeEmulatorBaseWith10StubASAndHosts(hostsPerStub=3)
emu.setBaseSystem(base)

# Create Ethereum service layer and sub-layer (blockchain)
eth_layer = EthereumService()
blockchain = eth_layer.createBlockchain(name="pos", consensus=ConsensusMechanism.POS)
blockchain.setTerminalTotalDifficulty(30)

# For each stub AS and each host, create blockchain virtual node, docker label, enable Geth HTTP, set roles, customize display names, and bind
asns = [asys.getAsn() for asys in base.getStubs()]
host_roles = {}  # Map: (asn, host_name) -> role

for asn in asns:
    asys = base.getAutonomousSystem(asn)
    hosts = asys.getHosts()
    for idx, host in enumerate(hosts):
        host_name = host.getName()
        vnode_name = f"eth-{asn}-{host_name}"
        # Create blockchain virtual node
        vnode = eth_layer.createNode(vnode_name)
        # Set Docker container label
        vnode.setLabel(f"eth-node-{asn}-{host_name}")
        # Enable Geth HTTP
        enableGethHttp(vnode)
        # Connect to blockchain
        connectToBlockchain(vnode, blockchain)
        # Bind virtual node to physical node
        emu.bind(vnode, host)
        # Set display name
        vnode.setDisplayName(f"Ethereum Node {asn}-{host_name}")

        # Assign roles:
        # - First host in AS 1 is BeaconSetupNode
        # - First host in AS 2 is BootNode
        # - First host in each AS is validator at genesis
        # - Second host in each AS is validator at running
        # - Others are normal nodes
        if asn == 1 and idx == 0:
            setBeaconSetupNode(vnode)
            vnode.setDisplayName(f"BeaconSetupNode {asn}-{host_name}")
        elif asn == 2 and idx == 0:
            setBootNode(vnode)
            vnode.setDisplayName(f"BootNode {asn}-{host_name}")
        elif idx == 0:
            enablePOSValidatorAtGenesis(vnode)
            vnode.setDisplayName(f"ValidatorAtGenesis {asn}-{host_name}")
        elif idx == 1:
            enablePOSValidatorAtRunning(vnode)
            vnode.setDisplayName(f"ValidatorAtRunning {asn}-{host_name}")

# Add Ethereum layer to emulator
emu.addLayer(eth_layer)

# Render and compile with Docker, internetMap and etherView enabled
emu.render()
emu.compile(
    Docker(),
    outputDirectory='./output',
    override=True,
    internetMap=True,
    etherView=True,
)
```
